evals.prompt: I just finished planning the API endpoint refactoring for the users module. We're splitting the monolithic /api/users endpoint into dedicated endpoints: GET /api/users, POST /api/users, GET /api/users/:id, PUT /api/users/:id, DELETE /api/users/:id. Each will have its own validation, authorization check, and response formatter. Can you generate a visual plan for this?

assertions.name: contains_mermaid_diagram

evals.prompt: We need a plan for migrating from MySQL to PostgreSQL. The plan covers: schema translation (data types, indexes, sequences), data migration strategy (batch export/import with verification), application config changes (database URL, connection pooling), rollback plan, and a timeline. Generate a visual plan with sequence diagrams for the migration flow and a Gantt chart for the timeline.
evals.expected_output: An MDX plan file saved to .opencode/plans/mysql-to-postgresql-migration/plan.mdx with sequence diagrams, Gantt chart, and rollback steps. URL http://localhost:2323/mysql-to-postgresql-migration printed.
